entries.title: Send someone you appreciate an official 'Continue and Persist' Letter
entries.author: adnanaga
entries.current_title: Send someone you appreciate an official 'Continue and Persist' Letter
entries.excerpt: Every day, thousands of Cease and Desist letters are issued, telling people to stop what they’re doing (Looking at you, David Chang). What a bummer! That’s why we created: The Continue and Persist Letter. A official-looking legal letter that encourages and uplifts people, one that tells people to keep doing what they’re doing! Surprise someone you appreciate by sending them a Continue and Persist Letter.
entries.guide_zh: 一个用仿法律函件鼓励他人继续坚持的创意项目。
